messages:
Maria S.: Heads-up — after last night's RBAC tighten in the EU keystore, a subset of proxy pods in eu-west-1 are failing to fetch TLS certs. KMS decrypts are returning AccessDenied. Observed ~20% of requests failing, causing 502 spikes. rotation-bot posted an alert.
Asha (eng-infra): on it. can you paste the minimal log lines and the service principal that hit AccessDenied?
Maria S.: log excerpt:
```
2026-03-22T23:05:12Z proxy-1234 ERROR fetch_cert: decrypt failed: KMSAccessDenied: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999999:key/abcd-efgh
principal=svc-proxy@eu-west-1 namespace=proxy
request_id=8f2a1b
```
also: the RBAC change PR was #4289 — we narrowed it to a tighter iam:AssumeRole scope for svc-proxy.
Tom (oncall): I can take a look now. quick hypothesis: role used to have kms:Decrypt via a delegated role, and the new policy removed the delegation. If you can reproduce with aws cli we can confirm.
Maria S.: trying CLI now — gives same error.
Asha (eng-infra): run this to mimic the pod identity (on your machine with creds):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999999:role/svc-proxy-eu --role-session-name test
# then with temporary creds
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999999:key/abcd-efgh --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode
```
should return plaintext or AccessDenied.
Oliver (platform): if it's the delegated role, we should either (A) revert the RBAC PR or (B) add explicit kms:Decrypt allow for the role in the key policy. For infra-safe immediate mitigation, add a temporary key policy grant scoped to the role arn and log it.
Priya (security): we need auditability. if we grant temporary access, add an audit tag with `x-correlation-id` or include `request_id` in KMS logs. Also capture the principal in the audit-log pipeline (we currently log only service name; expand to include assumed-role arn).
Leo (sre): agree on temp grant. Also we should enable a stricter fallback: if cert fetch fails, use cached certs for 5m rather than failing open. There's a pod-level env var `CERT_CACHE_TTL` we can bump.
Asha (eng-infra): quick policy snippet to add to KMS key policy (minimal):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowSvcProxyDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999999:role/svc-proxy-eu"},
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:RequestedRegion":"eu-west-1"}}
}
```
(note: apply as temporary emergency grant, we'll rotate to least-privilege after RCA)
Tom (oncall): applied temp key policy + redeployed proxy pods. deploy-bot: started rollout of proxy/replica-set proxy-eu v1.12.1 -> v1.12.2
deploy-bot: rollout in progress — 6/6 updated
Tom (oncall): after the temp grant and redeploy, cert fetch success rate back to normal. no more 502 spikes in last 12m.
Maria S.: good catch Tom/Asha. next steps for RCA:
- validate the RBAC PR scope that removed AssumeRole for the service (PR #4289) and open follow-up to re-add a scoped delegation
- update KMS key policies to require `kms:ViaService` + region condition for delegated roles
- add audit fields to cert-fetch logs: `assumed_role_arn`, `kms_key_id`, `request_id`
- add alerting rule for >5% cert-fetch failures over 5m
Priya (security): also add a short-lived incident tag in logs (incident_id=inc-20260322-eu-kms) so we can correlate across systems and satisfy compliance review.
Asha (eng-infra): I'll prepare the RBAC revert/adjust PR draft and the key-policy change doc. putting a TODO in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/keystore-rotation#emergency-key-policy
Leo (sre): suggest a postmortem with timeline + IAM diff + audit samples. I'll schedule the incident review tomorrow.
Maria S.: thanks everyone. filing ticket with actions and assigning: #INC-6321. If anyone sees anomalies, ping @here.
rotation-bot: Alert cleared — keystore:eu-west-1 fetch_errors returned to baseline.
